verdict.rationale: Spend tracking afterwards is documented. Responses report the realized cost in credits, credits map to dollars at $0.01 each, and the API platform claims cost visibility per model, endpoint and team. Pre-run cost visibility is only implied: there are published rate tiers (e.g. draft previews billed at the 480p rate) and a claim that you can score models by cost before committing, but no explicit cost estimate shown before a generation runs. Missing for 10: a documented pre-generation cost quote/estimate in the app or API, in-app credit-cost display for the marketer-facing creative product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spend dashboards.
